items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Do you remember who was in Lloyd Hunter's band... A fellow named McKinley was the guitar player.

ctx.x: You didn't tell me who was in that band. Do you remember who was in Lloyd Hunter's band, or any of the people?
Jimmy Bythewood was tenor player. A fellow named McKinley was the guitar player. Byron --
Little Byron -- Jimmy Byron was trombone.
